column1: # Domain suffix -> category, for destinations that have no brand identity but
# still mean something.  Used by the traffic page to label a flow when
# apps.tsv has no entry for it.
# Matching is by suffix and the *longest* match wins, so a rule for
# "example.co.uk" beats one for "co.uk".  A name found in apps.tsv always wins
# over a category - a real application name is more useful than "Cloud".
# The category must have a matching glyph in
# as dashes); the page falls back to a letter avatar when it is missing.
# Edit freely - the file is read on every sampling round.
